forbidden_shortcuts: post-hoc candidate-specific correction keyed by a frozen scenario

development_validation.seed_rule: All seeds and paired rounds from one scenario stay in the same fold.

uncertainty_rule: If the two lowest predicted costs differ by less than the frozen practical-equivalence margin, select the conservative legal default and report a fallback.
independent_holdout_rule: Only after development gates pass may a model be frozen. The holdout must use unseen row counts, batch sizes, policy combinations and seeds, and may be run once.
failure_rule: If grouped development fails, retain the negative model result and proceed to paper assembly without changing the admitted workload labels.
